## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement / refactoring

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the project's coding guidelines.
- [ ] I have run `mvn test` and confirmed all 40+ unit and integration tests pass.

- [ ] I have updated documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`, `INSTALLATION.md`) where appropriate.
- [ ] No plaintext secrets or credential tokens are committed.
